errors.text_span: Оста Y е етикетирана като „Индустрия (с изкл. на строителството) Общо“
errors.evidence: The text "Индустрия (с изкл. на строителството) Общо" is the title of the chart, not the label for the Y-axis. The Y-axis is not labeled.

The chart contains two lines: a solid blue line and a dotted blue line underneath it (representing the trend, as per the paper's caption). The description incorrectly states there is only one line and fails to mention the dotted trend line.
